_meta.description: Amazon Ads Sponsored Display per campaign per marketplace-local day (Reporting v3 sdCampaigns). Retired: v3 report collection stopped for every store on 2026-11-20; Ads data from 2026-09-01 is in v_ads_campaign_daily (ad_product = 'Sponsored Display'), and this table is deleted on 2026-12-31.
_meta.retention_note: rows older than 730 days are pruned nightly (newest snapshot per store never pruned where applicable); query beyond the window returns a report_date_note
caveats: For any day from 2026-09-01 read v_ads_campaign_daily with ad_product = 'Sponsored Display'; use this table only for days before 2026-09-01, until it is deleted on 2026-12-31. Split a range at 2026-09-01 and never add the two: the same Ads data is in both.

Columns there: campaign_name, campaign_status → campaign_state, campaign_budget_amount (Sponsored Brands and Display: campaign_budget) → campaign_budget, campaign_budget_type and portfolio_id there are the campaign's CURRENT values. cost → total_cost; impressions, clicks, purchases, sales, units_sold, detail_page_views, add_to_cart and new_to_brand_purchases / _sales / _units_sold / _detail_page_views as named; every *_clicks column → *_from_clicks and every *_views column → *_from_views; purchases_promoted_clicks → purchases_from_clicks_promoted, sales_promoted_clicks → sales_from_clicks_promoted; impressions_views → viewable_impressions; the video_* columns → *_video_ad as for Sponsored Brands. Both are 14-day attribution. cumulative_reach and impressions_frequency_average have no Stream twin; rates and e_cp_* are not stored: compute them from the sums. currency_code → currency.
Its rows stop on 2026-11-20, when v3 collection ended for every store (its schedules read superseded_by_stream): its newest day is not the newest Ads data.

columns.note: Marketplace this ads row belongs to. Query ads data per (store, country_code) directly — no need to reverse-map profile_id.
Internal tenant scope — auto-applied from `store`; never filter on it manually.
Ads profile id (one per marketplace) — auto-filtered from the store suffix; do not filter manually.

Row ingest timestamp (UTC). Bookkeeping, not business data. UTC instant (timestamptz). Query results show it in the store ref's marketplace local time, without an offset; a bare date in a filter is that marketplace's midnight.
JSON of Amazon columns with no dedicated DB column (unmapped/new headers land here).
